headline: 7 bosses in record pace, then Nefarian's landing cost twelve lives in twelve seconds

mvp.headline: 96 average, never under 91, and still nowhere near the top of the damage meter
why: 98 on Broodlord, Firemaw and Chromaggus, 96 on Nefarian, the highest average parse in the raid
Alive through the Nefarian landing that killed twelve, though Bellowing Roar feared him four times for the effort

also.text: 9 Fear Wards, 4 of them on Nefarian, and 3 Power Infusions

overview: 37:42 for the full clear against the guild's usual 47:53, with the first seven bosses all well under their medians: Vaelastrasz in 0:27 ties the guild record, Firemaw (0:51) and Chromaggus (1:24) were half a minute or more under.
Seventeen boss deaths, twelve of them on Nefarian. Raid DPS was far over the usual on the drakes, 37k on Vaelastrasz against 22k.
Well buffed: at Broodlord 35 of 40 had Rallying Cry, 34 Zandalar and 26 Songflower.

wentWell.text: Vaelastrasz in 0:27, equal to the guild record, on 37k raid DPS (usually 22k) with no deaths.
Firemaw in 0:51 against a median of 1:41, so Flame Buffet stacked half as high as usual.
Chromaggus in 1:24 (median 1:57) with no deaths. Four of his five Frenzies were Tranquilized, and Pinkcheese cleansed 20 afflictions.

notes.text: 0:27 once Razorgore was up. Razorgore's own melee killed Eduard at 0:07 and Tochopolvo at 0:27, and Conflagration did 28k, four times the usual share.
0:27, equal to the guild record, no deaths. Macharius 96, Necroshadow 94.
0:38 against a median of 0:50, no deaths. Skoomael 98, Yulepunch and Tochopolvo 97.
0:51 against a median of 1:41, on twice the usual raid DPS.
Shadow Flame hit 12 raiders and killed Malyric, Mstermage and Speldosan at 0:29 and 0:30, all already worn down by Flame Buffet.
0:51 against a median of 1:15, no deaths. Donatelios 98.
0:54, no deaths, Fire Nova hitting under half its usual rate. Five Tranquilizing Shots from Speldosan, Birdiebird and Darkestnight.
1:24 with no deaths. 57 afflictions cleansed (Pinkcheese 20, Rajja 10) and 4 of 5 Frenzies Tranquilized.

The landing Shadow Flame killed the main tank Macharius at 0:03. Wellan picked Nefarian up at 0:06, and at 0:08 the next Shadow Flame went through 34 of the 40 raiders for 4 to 7k each, and ten of them were dead by 0:11.

From there it was a 2:53 kill with 12 deaths, against a usual 2:25 with two Shadow Flame deaths. Most likely Nefarian was facing the raid when Wellan took him, but the log can't show positions well enough to be sure.
Ishilly, Norgewian and Thormund put out 12 Fear Wards, and Cladá removed two Veils of Shadow.
